news.title: Police presence in Conyers residential neighborhood
news.summary: Conyers Police said Wednesday they were assisting the Cobb County Police Department in executing an arrest/search warrant.

news.title: Marietta 2-year-old found dead in woods loved dinosaurs, spending time at pool
news.summary: Messiah Harris, who was about about to turn three in a few weeks, was found dead in the woods near the apartment complex on Ridge Run on Friday. Officials have not released a cause of death.

news.title: Newnan man held daughter hostage during standoff, sheriff's office says
news.summary: Coweta County deputies say a 14-year-old girl escaped a Newnan home after allegedly being assaulted and held against her will by her father.

news.title: Audit of Flock Safety use underway in Atlanta Police Department
news.summary: After a rash of investigations across Georgia looking into officers accused of misusing Flock Safety, the Atlanta Police Department is taking steps to ensure it’s not happening here.

news.title: Floyd County felony murder suspect arrested in Cherokee County
news.summary: Floyd County authorities say William Roger Caver was arrested Tuesday night in Cherokee County.

news.title: ICE says Georgia operation led to more than 1,200 arrests
news.summary: ICE says 1,226 undocumented immigrants were arrested during Operation Safe Community Atlanta.

news.title: 20-year-old killed after being shot multiple times in his DeKalb County apartment, family says
news.summary: His family said that someone came into his apartment and shot him six to seven times.

news.title: 1 dead after Bartow deputy shoots suspect in Cartersville: GBI
news.summary: The GBI said 31-year-old Marcus Maurice Williams died from his injuries.

news.title: Fourth arrest made in case of Atlanta man killed, found dumped in Douglas County reservoir
news.summary: The Douglas County Sheriff's Office said a deceased male was first recovered from Dog River Reservoir on May 15.

news.title: Suspect dies after McDonald's threat led to Bartow deputy shooting
news.summary: A Bartow County deputy fired their weapon Tuesday morning after a person allegedly pulled a gun on an employee at a McDonald's on Joe Frank Harris Parkway SE.
